subject: Re: Quick question on CCPA SP vs Operator carve-outs for AcmeCloud pilot
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acmecloud.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: paul.rivera@acmecloud.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial DPA redline + question on SP/operator classification for pilot

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We circulated the DPA with our privacy team and attached a redline (ACME_DPA_redline_v2.pdf). Two quick asks before we lock the pilot: 

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a "Service Provider" / "limited use" role for the pilot (specifically for CPRA/CCPA purposes), or whether there are any functions where Redwood would assert "Operator" rights? Our legal team needs clarity to proceed.

2) Telemetry: we've noted in the redline a concern about telemetry/telemetry aggregates being used for product improvement. Could you confirm what telemetry you collect, where it flows (onshore/offshore), and whether Redwood would consider an onshore-only fallback for our pilot telemetry if needed?

We'd appreciate a short written confirmation we can attach to our procurement folder. Attached is the redline.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Senior Privacy Counsel
AcmeCloud

[Attachment: ACME_DPA_redline_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

Ellen —

Appreciate the redline and the clear questions. High level before I loop Legal: Redwood's default posture for hosted/managed API customers is to operate as a Service Provider / limited-use processor with respect to customer content — we do not "sell" customer content and our platform is designed for limited-use telemetry for performance and product safety. That said, there are nuance points for dedicated or private on-prem deployments.

Proposed next steps: 
- I'll schedule a 30-min sync with you and Paul so we can walk the redline and telemetry list.
- Laura (cc) will provide suggested language we can offer as an attestation for the pilot.
- Ben (cc) can prepare a short telemetry sheet showing exact fields collected and where data is stored/processed.

Can you do tomorrow 10:00am PT for a quick call? If not, propose two slots.

Thanks — happy to get this over the finish line.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acmecloud.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-09T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redline + question on SP/operator classification for pilot

Ellen / Sean —

Thanks for the context. Short legal position and a suggested snippet you can use in the DPA or an accompanying attestation for the pilot: 

1) Position: For the hosted Redwood API used by AcmeCloud under the pilot, Redwood will act as a Service Provider ("limited use processor") and will process customer Content only as directed under the agreement and for the limited purposes of providing inference, model hosting, and essential service improvements (security, reliability, safety). Redwood will not engage in the sale of Personal Information as defined by CCPA/CPRA.

2) Telemetry carve-out (suggested language): "Redwood may collect non-consumable telemetry and operational metrics (e.g., request latencies, error rates, provisioning metrics, aggregate token counts) for the sole purpose of maintaining and improving service reliability and safety. Such telemetry will be processed in aggregate and will not be used to infer or derive individual customer profiles or sold to third parties. Upon Customer request during the Pilot, Redwood will offer an onshore-only telemetry handling option for the metrics identified in Schedule A."

3) Sale exemption: Include our standard examiner: "Redwood does not retain, aggregate, or monetize Customer Content for commercial resale. Any analytics performed on Content for product improvement will be within the scope of service provisioning and safety and subject to Customer-configured opt-outs where applicable."

If you'd like, I can produce a one-paragraph attestation (on Redwood letterhead) that you can attach to procurement. Ben, please flag any telemetry fields that would break an onshore-only path.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

[Attachment: suggested_clause_snippet.txt (text, 1.2KB)]
